scope: Captured start requests. Admission tests do not establish Minecraft execution.

starts.instructions: Initiate a Minecraft session to fulfill Jesse's request for tree-punching and building/destroying, providing a concrete outlet for his frustration with Dave.

arguments.goal: Punch trees and build or destroy structures as requested by Jesse to help him forget Dave exists.
